cards.title: Why tantrums happen and how to help
cards.body: You can't stop a tantrum on command, but you can help build the brain that learns to manage emotions. Understanding the science of lending your calm helps children develop better emotional regulation.

cards.title: Protecting vulnerable families before crisis hits
cards.body: Early identification of vulnerabilities in family care can prevent many families from reaching crisis point. Intervention strategies may reduce the need for more drastic measures later.

cards.title: A pediatrician on connection over screens
cards.body: Loss of human connection poses a bigger threat to children than AI or technology itself. The solution isn't limiting screens but spending more time talking openly with each other.

cards.title: Making Halloween magical for your kids
cards.body: Celebrating autumn traditions can create moments of magic and connection for families. It's an opportunity to step past cynicism and engage meaningfully with children.

cards.title: Great-grandmother becomes kinship carer at 74
cards.body: A Somerset great-grandmother found purpose and fulfillment by taking in her great-grandchildren after her daughter died. Kinship care arrangements can provide stability for children while helping older relatives.
